assets.name: 白狼
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: portrait illustration for a Godot card battle game, a single character artwork without any card frame.
Primary request: redraw the character from the supplied original Onmyoji: The Card Game reference with high identity fidelity. The reference is a visual reference only. Create a fresh, higher resolution illustration, not a screenshot enlargement and not a finished card.
Style/medium: closely match the reference's Japanese fantasy card art: elegant clean ink contours, planar cel painted shapes, softly textured washi paper, carefully controlled decorative patterns, muted mineral pigments and restrained antique gold accents. Preserve the reference's stylized anatomy and delicate face. Avoid generic glossy gacha rendering, photorealism or generic chibi redesign.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3 portrait, 1024 by 1536 pixels or larger. Character fills the frame, face in the central horizontal area at around the upper third, complete head inside the frame, readable upper body and signature props, flowing fabric toward the bottom. Keep key character details in the central 65% of width for narrow portrait and landscape card crops. Quiet patterned background derived from the reference.
Constraints: faithfully retain hairstyle, face, costume silhouette, ornaments, signature props and palette in the reference. No words, no UI symbols, no lettering, no numbers, no nameplate, no border, no watermark. Do not invent a new outfit. One featured shikigami only; retain a signature mount or spirit creature only when explicitly in the reference.
Subject: 白狼 / Hakuro. Preserve her white wolf ears, silver-white high ponytail tied with red ornaments, fair female face, white furry tail, dark indigo sleeveless archery outfit, navy-gold layered pleated skirt, red waist cord, pale legs with dark wraps. Hold the enormous red and black longbow upright and an arrow with a steady archer's stance. Background: muted sage-gray clouds, restrained gold patterns.
